desc: The Midwest Industries Optic Rail Shell Holder is a versatile accessory that combines optic mounting and ammunition storage for lever-action firearms. Constructed from hard coat anodized 6061 aluminum, it maintains the firearm's classic aesthetics while providing modern functionality. The rail includes three universal shell holders, accommodating up to six rounds, which can be oriented vertically or horizontally based on user preference. Nylon-tipped stainless steel set screws safeguard the receiver's finish during side impacts.
